tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground of the workspace app, sign-in and settings.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on background, card and popover (19.7:1 light, 20.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: record panels, quote and invoice editors, settings groups.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the ⌘K command palette, dropdowns, tooltips.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected nav, logo ink in light. Dark fill is 1.9:1 on background, so label it.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on primary (17.8:1 light, 10.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, selected rows, soft chips.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary (6.1:1 light, 17.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table header rows, empty states, disabled controls.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders on background and muted (≥5.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and focus fill for list rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent (6.0:1 light, 15.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, void, overdue. As text on background: 4.6:1 light, 6.5:1 dark (dark was 2.1:1).

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels on destructive: white in light (4.7:1), near-black in dark (6.4:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only (1.3:1): never the sole sign of an input.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and select outlines; same caveat as border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid. 3.7:1 on background in light, 5.4:1 in dark (adjusted from the supplied 1.7:1).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Electric blue. First chart series and the logo's blue. 7.1:1 light, 5.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (violet in light, amber in dark).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series. Dark value is low-contrast on background; use it for fills, not lines.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Workspace sidebar ground, Biz4Kit chrome only.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Nav labels on sidebar (14.8:1 light, 5.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Workspace-switcher chip behind the business logo; near-white in both themes so any logo reads.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Active nav label on sidebar-accent (16.2:1 light, 17.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar: 10:1 in light, 5.0:1 in dark (adjusted from the supplied 1.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Logo wordmark and kit tiles: indigo on light grounds, near-white on dark.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The logo's 4 and coin. Never used for body text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, accepted, approved, done (D51). Text on background and on success-soft (4.8:1 light).

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels on a solid success fill (5.0:1 light, 10.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind Paid / Accepted pills; text is success (4.8:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due, tentative, expired, snoozed, invited (D51; waiting for approval moved to violet, D55). Text on warning-soft 4.8:1 light.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels on a solid warning fill (5.0:1 light, 11.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind Due pills; text is warning (4.8:1 light, 10.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Shared, new lead, in progress (D55). Text on info-soft (6.2:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels on a solid info fill.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info status pills; text is info (6.2:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Viewed, quoted, invoiced, waiting for approval (D55). Text on violet-soft (6.5:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: violet-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels on a solid violet fill.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind violet status pills; text is violet (6.5:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Part paid (D55). Text on teal-soft (5.2:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels on a solid teal fill.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind teal status pills; text is teal (5.2:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-paid
tokens.usage: Alias: money state Paid. Always with the word and an icon.

tokens.name: status-due
tokens.usage: Alias: money state Due.

tokens.name: status-overdue
tokens.usage: Alias: money state Overdue. Pills use the solid fill with destructive-foreground; no soft red passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: customer-border
tokens.usage: Customer pages: dividers. Decorative.

tokens.name: biz-accent
